reason: The successful dual-GPU llama-bench output does not report context-specific prompt_ms and predicted_ms separately from the combined p+g run; do not derive decode TPS by subtracting unrelated runs.
method: Use the already pinned PrismML llama-server and its local POST /completion endpoint. The endpoint accepts token ID arrays for prompt, reports timings.prompt_n/cache_n/prompt_ms/predicted_n/predicted_ms, and supports cache_prompt=false. Derive prefill TPS = prompt_n/(prompt_ms/1000), decode TPS = predicted_n/(predicted_ms/1000), both from the same request. Record client wall time separately.
per_level_server_context: round prompt_tokens + 128 completion capacity up to the next 256-token boundary; 256K profile set to native 262144.

profile.model: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 exact GGUF pin from A17
profile.sampling: temperature .6, top_p .95, top_k 20, min_p 0, repeat 1, presence 0, seed 42

prompt: Deterministic varied synthetic prose tokenized by the running pinned server /tokenize route, then tiled as token IDs to exactly the requested prompt count; raw token array sent to /completion. No chat template. Each request records cache_n; valid result requires cache_n=0 and prompt_n equals requested count.
readiness: Before each level, fresh zero-server preflight, start only the scoped localhost server, verify /health, tokenize fixture, send an unscored READY smoke, and confirm both GPUs have >1 GiB allocations. Run the registered samples serially, then stop only the owned server.
stop_conditions: any external inference server found before level
one GPU lacks model allocation within 45s
prompt cache_n nonzero or prompt count mismatch
context rejection, OOM, crash, or MemAvailable below 32 GiB for four consecutive 15s samples
quality_reference: Reuse Q172 PrismML 75/100; critical TC-74/84/92 failures. No quality rerun and no adoption.
